proposed_behavior_decisions.behavior: One automatic post; nonempty affected installed-skill union -> all; unchanged announceable new release -> skill-release. Existing same-current suppression and opt-out unchanged.
proposed_behavior_decisions.benefit: Matches the currently documented ordinary all-plus-relevant selector without changing generic board semantics or first updating already-running subscribers.
proposed_behavior_decisions.cost_and_compatibility: Changed notices stop matching skill-release-only listeners, which must include all. Every collected all match can incur a model wake even if affected skills are irrelevant to that receiver; only changed installed content uses this broad route. No numeric wake-cost estimate for this run.

proposed_behavior_decisions.behavior: Add compact consumer relevance/refresh guidance only in coordination-channels, preserving canonical release/loading and DESIGN7 ownership. Still-installed relevant loaded guidance is re-read; removed guidance becomes an owned missing-guidance dependency, not a fictitious refresh. Keep task context and exposure/authority boundaries.

Real publisher/post/wait fixture plus a named retained-consumer rehearsal before next dependent fixture action; keep publication, selector, observed receipt and read evidence separate. No global listener or real deployment claim.

alternatives.behavior: Keep all automatic notices on skill-release; explicitly add skill-release to relevant subscriber selections.
alternatives.already_running: Existing all-plus-relevant listeners lacking skill-release remain ineligible until deliberately reconfigured; updated instruction text cannot bootstrap its own observation. Need an explicit existing-session delivery/update owner and replay from before skipped rows. No complete listener inventory is established.
alternatives.wake_consequence: Relevant subscribers wake for all skill-release publications, including unchanged-content new-release notices unless another allowed mechanism reduces that cost; all remains its existing broad subscription.
alternatives.why_not_proposed: Does not alone close the current ordinary listener gap; would require an additional bootstrap/session-update commitment. Human can choose it by accepting revised exact candidate/packets.
